verdict.rationale: The quickstart says the free plan includes 3 agents with no card required, so developers can start without contacting sales. Signup is fully self-serve: install the CLI via npm, mint a key yourself, and deploy a first agent in under 5 minutes. Missing for 10: details of the free plan's limits beyond agent count (e.g., how much of the default metered LLM access is included), and independent or hands-on confirmation of the no-card signup flow.
